q: No sooner had the bell rung than the students rushed out.
No sooner the bell had rung than the students rushed out.
No sooner did the bell rang than the students rushed out.
No sooner had the bell rung when the students rushed out.
'No sooner' takes inversion (had + subject + past participle) and pairs with 'than'. GPSC-style practice item, modelled on the 2026 grammar blocks.
Identify the error: “Each of the nurses have been given a new uniform.”
'Each of' takes a singular verb: 'has been given'. GPSC-style practice item, modelled on the 2026 grammar blocks.
Choose the correct passive construction: “They say that he is honest.”
It is said him to be honest.
He was said to be honest.
He is said to be honest.
Report-verb passive: subject + is said + to-infinitive. GPSC-style practice item, modelled on the 2026 grammar blocks.
Choose the correct tense: “By the time the ambulance arrived, the patient ______ consciousness.”
An earlier past action before another past action takes the past perfect. GPSC-style practice item, modelled on the 2026 grammar blocks.
Identify the clause type: “What the doctor said surprised everyone.”
The clause is the subject of 'surprised', so it is a noun clause. GPSC-style practice item, modelled on the 2026 grammar blocks.
If he left earlier, he would have caught the train.
If he would have left earlier, he would have caught the train.
If he had left earlier, he would have caught the train.
If he had left earlier, he would catch the train yesterday.
Third conditional: if + past perfect, would have + past participle. Never 'would have' in the if-clause. GPSC-style practice item, modelled on the 2026 grammar blocks.
Find the error: “The list of approved candidates are displayed on the notice board.”
The subject is 'list' (singular): 'is displayed'. GPSC-style practice item, modelled on the 2026 grammar blocks.
Choose the correct passive construction: “Someone has stolen my bag.”
Present perfect passive: has been + past participle; drop 'someone'. GPSC-style practice item, modelled on the 2026 grammar blocks.
Choose the correct modal: “You ______ wear a helmet; it is the law.”
'Must' expresses obligation. GPSC-style practice item, modelled on the 2026 grammar blocks.
Choose the correct preposition: “He is accused ______ taking a bribe.”
'Accused of'; but 'charged with'. GPSC-style practice item, modelled on the 2026 grammar blocks.
Choose the correct option: “It is high time we ______ the old files.”
'It is high time' + subject + past tense (subjunctive). GPSC-style practice item, modelled on the 2026 grammar blocks.
Spot the error: “Either the clerk or the officers is responsible for the delay.”
With either/or, the verb agrees with the nearer subject ('officers'): 'are'. GPSC-style practice item, modelled on the 2026 grammar blocks.
Choose the correct passive construction: “Who wrote this letter?”
By whom was this letter written?
By whom was written this letter?
By whom this letter was written?
Question form: By whom + was + subject + past participle. GPSC-style practice item, modelled on the 2026 grammar blocks.
Choose the correct tense: “She ______ in this hospital since 2015.”
An action from a past point continuing now, with 'since': present perfect (continuous). GPSC-style practice item, modelled on the 2026 grammar blocks.
Choose the correct idiom: “The new scheme was a great success.” (meaning)
'Take off' = become successful; 'fall flat' and 'fall through' = fail. GPSC-style practice item, modelled on the 2026 grammar blocks.

Seldom have I met so honest an officer.

Seldom I have met so honest an officer.

Identify the error: “I am knowing the new doctor since last year.”
'Know' is a stative verb, and 'since' needs the present perfect: 'I have known'. GPSC-style practice item, modelled on the 2026 grammar blocks.
Choose the correct passive construction: “Open the window.”
Imperative passive: Let + object + be + past participle. GPSC-style practice item, modelled on the 2026 grammar blocks.
Choose the correct modal: “He looks pale; he ______ be unwell.”
'Must' for a confident deduction. GPSC-style practice item, modelled on the 2026 grammar blocks.

'In order to succeed' tells why he worked hard. GPSC-style practice item, modelled on the 2026 grammar blocks.

'Wish' about the present takes the past form (subjunctive). GPSC-style practice item, modelled on the 2026 grammar blocks.
Find the error: “He has been living in Panaji for 2019.”

Select the correct indirect speech: He said, “I am tired.”

He said that I was tired.
He said that he is tired.

Identify the conjunction relationship: “Although he was ill, he attended office.”

She is the more intelligent of the two sisters.

The cattle are grazing in the field.
The jury has given its verdict.

The doctor said me to take this medicine twice a day.

Choose the correct modal: “You ______ have told me earlier; I could have helped.”

'Neither of' takes a singular verb: 'is correct'. GPSC-style practice item, modelled on the 2026 grammar blocks.
Choose the correct transformation of: “He is too proud to apologise.”

He is proud enough to apologise.

He is so proud that he will apologise.

Choose the correct tense: “By next March, they ______ the new hospital wing.”

Choose the correct phrasal verb: “The meeting was ______ because the Collector was unwell.”

Choose the correct option: “Hardly had the meeting begun ______ the power failed.”

He gave me a piece of advice.

Choose the correct passive construction: “The committee will announce the results tomorrow.”
The results will be announce by the committee tomorrow.
The results will announced by the committee tomorrow.

'May' for polite permission. GPSC-style practice item, modelled on the 2026 grammar blocks.

'Yesterday' tells when he came. GPSC-style practice item, modelled on the 2026 grammar blocks.
He spoke as if he were the owner of the house.
He spoke as if he is the owner of the house.
He spoke as if he being the owner of the house.

Identify the conjunction relationship: “Walk carefully, lest you should fall.”

This hospital is more better equipped than any other hospital in the district.
This hospital is better equipped than any hospital in the district.
This hospital is best equipped than any other hospital in the district.
This hospital is better equipped than any other hospital in the district.

He was ordered to submit the documents.
He is ordered to submit the documents.
He was ordered submitting the documents.

If I was the director, I would approve the funding.
If I were the director, I would approve the funding.

Angry at a thing (angry with a person). GPSC CBRT, May 2026.

She is expected to complete the task soon.
She expected to complete the task soon.
She is expected completing the task soon.

Choose the correct preposition: “She is skilled ____ solving complex problems.”
